title: A Verdict for the Cipher Again
author: Juniper Hartwell
blurb: Odile Dravenmoor, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
